n1.speaker: schooloffice
n1.text: Good morning, Maple Grove Primary, Mrs Price speaking.

translations.fa: صبح بخیر، دبستان میپل گروو، خانم پرایس هستم.

branches.suggestion: Hello. I'm calling to report an absence. Nicola Thompson won't be in today.
branches.suggestionFa: سلام. زنگ زدم غیبت گزارش بدم. نیکولا تامپسون امروز نمیاد.

branches.suggestion: Hi. I'm afraid Nicola Thompson is ill today.
branches.suggestionFa: سلام. متأسفانه نیکولا تامپسون امروز مریضه.

n2.speaker: schooloffice
n2.text: Thank you for letting us know. Which class is she in?

translations.fa: ممنون که خبر دادید. تو کدوم کلاسه؟

branches.suggestion: She's in Year 2, Miss Hart's class.

branches.suggestionFa: کلاس دوم — کلاس رابین‌ها، فکر کنم.

cultureNote.en: Primary classes in England often have animal or tree names, like "Robins" or "Oak".
cultureNote.fa: کلاس‌ها اغلب اسم حیوان یا درخت دارند.

n3.speaker: schooloffice
n3.text: Lovely. And what's the reason for the absence?

branches.suggestion: She's been sick in the night and has a temperature.
branches.suggestionFa: شب استفراغ کرده و تب داره.

branches.suggestion: She's got a bad cold and a cough.

n4.speaker: schooloffice
n4.text: Oh dear. If it's sickness, she needs to stay off for 48 hours after the last time she was sick.

translations.fa: آخ. اگه استفراغه، باید تا ۴۸ ساعت بعد از آخرین باری که استفراغ کرده خونه بمونه.

branches.suggestion: Forty-eight hours? So she'll be back on Thursday?
branches.suggestionFa: چهل و هشت ساعت؟ پس پنجشنبه برمی‌گرده؟

branches.suggestion: I didn't know that rule. Thank you.

cultureNote.en: The "48-hour rule" for sickness and diarrhoea helps stop bugs spreading in schools.
cultureNote.fa: قانون ۴۸ ساعته برای جلوگیری از شیوع است.

recasts.echo: She'll come back on Thursday? Yes, if she's well.

n5.speaker: schooloffice
n5.text: Exactly, as long as she's well. Can I check — are you on our contact list?

translations.fa: دقیقاً، به شرطی که خوب باشه. می‌تونم چک کنم — شما تو فهرست تماس ما هستید؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I'm a family friend. Leslie added me last term.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، دوست خانوادگی‌ام. لزلی ترم پیش اضافه‌م کرد.

branches.suggestion: I'm not sure. Leslie asked me to call.
branches.suggestionFa: مطمئن نیستم. لزلی ازم خواست زنگ بزنم.

n6.speaker: schooloffice
n6.text: I can see you here — that's fine. Oh, one thing: it's the school trip on Friday.

translations.fa: اینجا می‌بینمتون — مشکلی نیست. اوه، یه چیز: جمعه اردوی مدرسه‌ست.

branches.suggestion: Will she still be able to go?

n7.speaker: schooloffice
n7.text: She can still go if she's better. But we haven't had the consent form back yet.

translations.fa: اگه بهتر باشه هنوز می‌تونه بره. ولی هنوز فرم رضایت را پس نگرفتیم.

branches.suggestion: I'll ask Leslie to sign it tonight.
branches.suggestionFa: از لزلی می‌خوام امشب امضاش کنه.

n8.speaker: schooloffice
n8.text: Yes, on the school app — it's quicker. Would you like me to send the work home for her?

translations.fa: آره، تو اپ مدرسه — سریع‌تره. می‌خواید تکالیفش را بفرستم خونه؟

branches.suggestion: That would be great, thank you.

n9.speaker: schooloffice
n9.text: Lovely. I've marked her as ill. I hope she feels better soon — give her our love!

translations.fa: عالی. غیبتش را مریضی ثبت کردم. امیدوارم زود خوب بشه — از طرف ما سلام برسونید!
